brief:
Britain will not accept Palestinian displacement or the continuation of illegal occupation, Foreign Secretary David Lammy said, the Maan news agency reported. Lammy's comments articulate London's position on the status quo in Palestinian territories and international law regarding settlement expansion.

The remarks reflect Britain's official stance against forced population transfer and unlawful territorial control, though they offer no new policy initiatives or timeline for enforcement of such principles.
title: Britain's foreign secretary rejects Palestinian displacement and illegal occupation
